p: cause his face to shine upon: That is, move our hearts with his Holy Spirit, that we may feel his favour toward us.
thy way may be known upon: That both Jews and Gentiles may know God's covenant made with them.
O let the nations be glad: By these repetitions he shows that the people can never rejoice and give thanks enough for the great benefits that they will receive under the kingdom of Christ.
the earth yield her increase: He shows that where God favours there will be abundance of all other things.
shall fear him: When they feel his great benefits both spiritual and corporal toward them.
